label: Find and read my files
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I connected Dropbox so the assistant could find and read my files. I did not want it creating links anyone can open, and I did not want it deleting or moving anything.

notes.create.record.world: refused; the scope grants it, and the eight come together
notes.delete.file.host: refused; recoverable for a while, on some plans

provenance.note: Written on this site as the starting mandate for a connector shape the model site has not published. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is a first draft written to be argued with. `unstated` is the primitives the mandate names neither way.
